differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia due to chronic gastrointestinal blood loss (e.g., colon neoplasm)
differential.rationale: Age 55, anemia with relatively normal MCV and low platelet count raise concern for occult GI bleed, especially with obesity and hypertension risk factors.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease secondary to chronic inflammatory conditions (COPD, OSA, fibromyalgia)
differential.rationale: Long‑standing inflammatory disorders can suppress erythropoiesis, producing mild normocytic anemia and thrombocytopenia.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Presents in middle‑aged adults with unexplained anemia and cytopenias (low platelets), and is associated with prior exposure to toxins or chronic disease.

differential.name: Vitamin B12 deficiency (pernicious anemia)
differential.rationale: Can cause macrocytic anemia and thrombocytopenia; risk increases with age and may be masked by concurrent chronic illnesses.

differential.name: Aplastic anemia
differential.rationale: Rare but fits the pattern of pancytopenia (low platelets, anemia) without obvious marrow infiltrative disease.
